Uptake of water by dry seed materials (cell walls, starch, protein), which swell.
Loss of water vapour from the aerial parts of a plant, mainly through the stomata.
Root hair (osmosis) → cortex → xylem of root and stem → leaf veins → mesophyll → evaporation → water vapour out of stomata.
Higher temperature, stronger wind, brighter light, lower humidity.
